rows.brief: Plan 1. A workshop 22 m wide (east-west) by 15 m deep (north-south). Goods come in through a dock on the west wall and leave through a dock on the west wall. Process flow: inspect then kitting then assembly then prep. Equipment: 1 inspect station, 1 kitting station, 1 assembly station, 2 prep stations. Demand is 26 units per hour. Power comes in at the south wall and water at the south wall. Put storage right beside the inbound dock.

Plan 2. A workshop 21 m wide (east-west) by 14 m deep (north-south). Goods come in through a dock on the west wall and leave through a dock on the east wall. Process flow: storage then kitting then inspect then pack. Equipment: 1 storage station, 1 kitting station, 2 inspect stations, 2 pack stations. Demand is 31 units per hour. Power comes in at the east wall and water at the west wall. Group stations of the same type side by side.

Plan 3. A workshop 20 m wide (east-west) by 14 m deep (north-south). Goods come in through a dock on the north wall and leave through a dock on the west wall. Process flow: paint then pack then storage then prep then assembly. Equipment: 1 paint station, 1 pack station, 3 storage stations, 1 prep station, 1 assembly station. Demand is 41 units per hour. Power comes in at the west wall and water at the west wall. Keep the middle of the floor clear for a main aisle.

Plan 4. A workshop 19 m wide (east-west) by 13 m deep (north-south). Goods come in through a dock on the east wall and leave through a dock on the east wall. Process flow: paint then test then storage then pack then kitting. Equipment: 3 paint stations, 1 test station, 2 storage stations, 1 pack station, 1 kitting station. Demand is 25 units per hour. Power comes in at the north wall and water at the south wall. Keep the middle of the floor clear for a main aisle.

Plan 5. A workshop 18 m wide (east-west) by 12 m deep (north-south). Goods come in through a dock on the east wall and leave through a dock on the east wall. Equipment: 3 paint stations, 2 kitting stations, 1 assembly station, 1 inspect station, 1 test station, 1 storage station. Demand is 44 units per hour. Power comes in at the south wall and water at the east wall. Line the stations along the walls.
